TaskDescription: Cued left- vs right-hand motor imagery on two separate days. Each session has four blocks of 30 trials (15 left, 15 right, random order) with 5 min breaks; each 7 s trial has a 1 s 'Ready' preparation (0.25 s beep), a 4 s task period showing a left- or right-handed rowing game animation with sound, then a 2 s rest. Released as one file per session without block boundaries. Trial duration: 4.0s.
InstitutionalDepartmentName: School of Precision Instruments and Optoelectronics Engineering
Description: Cross-session motor imagery EEG dataset from 14 subjects performing cued left- vs right-hand motor imagery across two sessions.
